text: {"score":3,"justification":"The core numbers match the card, and the leaning and caution are appropriate. But the narrative contains claims that contradict the card or that are overstated, and the next steps are thin. An investigator would have to recheck parts of it.","problems":["Headline says 99215 is above expectation \"at every complexity tier\", but the card does not support that. The 0-condition tier has 3.7% against 2.8% overall, which is barely above, and the 4-condition tier has 17.4% against 11.9%. The rationale repeats this as \"every condition-count band\".","Rationale says the excess is \"most pronounced among patients with one chronic condition\". By ratio that is plausible (15.9% vs 4.1%), but the 5+ band (50% vs 21.8%) is the largest absolute gap, so the claim is selective.","\"The excess 99215 billing is not explained by panel mix\" is stated too firmly for a summary that is labeled inconclusive, and it conflicts with the later hedging.","\"No sign of cloned documentation\" is overreach. The check only shows that notes claiming moderate-plus data review had lab lines; it does not test for cloning.","C0099148 is described as a low-complexity example, but the card shows no documentation for it. C0099099 is cited as a documented high-MDM note, yet it is a low-complexity claim (type 2 diabetes only); the summary does not weigh this tension, which is the key point for the investigator.","The 23% share of low-complexity 99215 is given, but the summary never says that the 5 documented 99215 claims are only a small subset of the 35 claims.","The final next_steps are generic (request a larger sample, re-screen). The specific chart-request steps appear only in the rationale text, and the next_steps list does not name the claims. The next_steps list also does not say what documentation to compare against.","Cited claim IDs are limited to two, although the rationale names others (C0099148, C0099102, C0099162, C0099099), so the citations are incomplete.","Does not flag missing items, such as the one missing minutes value on C0099113, or that the 0 below-billed rate gives little information given the small sample."]}
